# W0002: stale doc

The doc was written for the old signature. Update it, or, if it still holds, send the declaration back as it is, which pins it again.

- Rule: [`docs.stale`](../../reference/04-programs.md#docs.stale)
- Reported at: the first line of the doc.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `warnings` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`W0002_signature_changed_under_its_doc`](../../tests/diagnostics/W0002_signature_changed_under_its_doc):

`docs.lock`:

```text
main.weight #c87b #dbc4
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
type Order = { qty: i64, grams: i64 }

type Unit = | Grams | Kilograms

/// The weight of an order, in kilograms.
fn weight(o: Order, unit: Unit) -> i64 {
  match unit {
    Grams => o.qty * o.grams
    Kilograms => o.qty * o.grams / 1000
  }
}

fn main() / io { print("{weight(Order { qty: 2, grams: 600 }, Kilograms)}") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "orders"
```
